key.name: provider-order
key.description: Order of providers in the top bar and menus. Disabled providers stay in this list.

key.name: hidden-providers
key.description: Providers kept out of the top bar. Order is preserved when they are shown again.

key.name: auto-refresh
key.description: Whether to refresh provider data on a timer.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Minutes between automatic refreshes. The preferences window offers 1, 5, 15, and 30.

key.name: unavailable-display
key.description: How the top bar treats a provider that has no usable quota.

key.name: cached-data
key.description: Whether to keep showing the last successful quota when a later refresh fails. The timestamp is shown only in the menu.

key.name: use-web-icons
key.description: Download provider icons over HTTPS. When off, theme icons and the bundled fallbacks are used.

key.name: enabled
key.description: Whether this provider is active. Order and visibility are kept while it is disabled.

key.name: executable-path
key.description: Absolute path to the provider CLI. Empty uses automatic discovery.

key.name: top-bar-quota
key.description: Which quota percentage to show in the top bar.

key.name: show-plan
key.description: Whether the menu shows the subscription plan when the provider reports one.

key.name: show-billing
key.description: Whether the menu shows billing amounts when the provider reports them.

key.name: icon-url
key.description: HTTPS URL for this provider icon. Empty uses the built-in default.

key.name: allow-unofficial-sources
key.description: Allow this provider to read a local CLI session and call an unofficial usage endpoint. Off by default.
